title: Chris Evans reveals secret talks about his Avengers return
excerpt:
New information about the project has been announced.
Here is the confirmed news and its wider context.
body_md:
Chris Evans has revealed that discussions about continuing his Marvel Cinematic Universe career began before audiences saw Steve Rogers' apparent farewell in Avengers: Endgame. The actor is returning for Avengers: Doomsday despite previously expressing satisfaction with the conclusion of his original Captain America storyline.

Evans recalled meeting Marvel Studios executives Kevin Feige and Louis D'Esposito during the production of Endgame. They proposed continuing their collaboration, but with Steve Rogers operating under a different identity rather than retaining the Captain America title. The suggested persona was Nomad.

According to Evans, Marvel presented an appealing pitch. Nevertheless, he was happy with the way his character's journey had concluded and did not feel that the proposed continuation was something he wanted to pursue at that particular moment. His account indicates that Marvel was considering possibilities for Steve's future even before the release of his apparent departure.

At the end of the 2019 film, Steve chose to pursue a life with Peggy Carter and ultimately passed his shield to Sam Wilson, played by Anthony Mackie. That decision established an important transition in the franchise and allowed another character to carry the Captain America identity.

Nomad has an established history in Marvel's comic books. Steve Rogers adopted the identity during a period in which he abandoned the Captain America title. However, the existence of an earlier cinematic pitch does not confirm that Evans will portray Nomad in Doomsday. The proposal and the actor's current return should be treated as separate developments unless Marvel explicitly connects them.

Director Anthony Russo also discussed Evans' commitment to preserving surprises for theatrical audiences. His comments suggest that the actor places considerable importance on allowing viewers to discover major developments during the film rather than through advance publicity.

Promotional footage for Doomsday depicts Steve and Peggy in circumstances that appear different from the conclusion of Endgame. This has encouraged speculation about time travel and alternate universes, but the available report does not establish the precise mechanism behind their return.

From a storytelling perspective, bringing Steve Rogers back while Sam Wilson carries the Captain America legacy raises interesting questions about how Marvel will handle continuity and character development. Those questions cannot be resolved from promotional material alone.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to open on December 18, 2026. Evans' account offers insight into the franchise's earlier planning without establishing the full nature of his role in the upcoming film.
